{
  "name": "compose",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "type": "module",
  "description": "🧩 Design-Information-Modeling for Kit-of-Parts 🏘️",
  "workspaces": [
    "elements/ui",
    "compose/assets/logo",
    "compose/assets/icons",
    "compose/assets",
    "compose/py",
    "compose/engine",
    "compose/js",
    "compose/react",
    "compose/sites/docs",
    "compose/sites/play",
    "compose/desktop",
    "compose/algorithms",
    "repo/vscode",
    "compose/net/Compose",
    "compose/gh/Compose.Grasshopper",
    "compose/go",
    "repo/client",
    "repo/server",
    "compose/rs",
    "compose/sqlite",
    "repo/sqlite",
    "coda/assistant",
    "coda/desktop",
    "compose/assets/images",
    "compose/sketchpad",
    "compose/store",
    "compose/vscode",
    "compose/3dm/Compose.Rhino",
    "compose/3dm/ui",
    "compose/ui"
  ],
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.13.1"
  },
  "packageManager": "npm@11.7.0",
  "scripts": {
    "install:native": "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .devcontainer/install-native.ps1",
    "git:setup": "node -e \"const cp=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const root=process.cwd();const source='AGENTS.md';const aliases=['CLAUDE.md','GEMINI.md'];const run=(cmd,args)=>cp.execFileSync(cmd,args,{stdio:'inherit'});run('git',['config','--local','core.symlinks','true']);const repoClientCandidates=[path.join(root,'repo','client','client.exe'),path.join(root,'repo','client','client')];const repoClientPath=repoClientCandidates.find(candidate=>fs.existsSync(candidate));const repoClient=repoClientPath?{cmd:repoClientPath,args:['configure']}:{cmd:'go',args:['run','./repo/mcp','configure']};run(repoClient.cmd,repoClient.args);for(const alias of aliases){const aliasPath=path.join(root,alias);if(fs.existsSync(aliasPath))fs.rmSync(aliasPath,{force:true});try{fs.symlinkSync(source,aliasPath,'file');}catch(error){if(process.platform!=='win32')throw error;fs.linkSync(path.join(root,source),aliasPath);}}\"",
    "pre-commit:install": "pre-commit install",
    "pre-commit": "pre-commit run --all-files",
    "premcp:inspector": "npm --workspace @semio-tech/compose-engine run build:mcp-app",
    "mcp:inspector": "node -e \"const h=process.env.DEVCONTAINER==='true'?'0.0.0.0':'127.0.0.1';require('child_process').spawn('npx',['-y','@mcpjam/inspector@latest','uv','--directory',require('path').resolve('compose/engine'),'run','main.py','--mcp-stdio'],{stdio:'inherit',env:Object.assign({},process.env,{HOST:h}),shell:true}).on('exit',c=>process.exit(c||0))\"",
    "mcp:inspector:repo": "node -e \"const h=process.env.DEVCONTAINER==='true'?'0.0.0.0':'127.0.0.1';require('child_process').spawn('npx',['-y','@modelcontextprotocol/inspector','--config','.cursor/mcp.json','--server','repo'],{stdio:'inherit',env:Object.assign({},process.env,{HOST:h}),shell:true}).on('exit',c=>process.exit(c||0))\"",
    "dev:elements:ui:storybook": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @elements/ui",
    "dev:js:sketchpad": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev:sketchpad @semio-tech/compose-js",
    "dev:3dm:ui": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @semio-tech/compose-3dm-ui",
    "dev:sites:play": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad-play",
    "dev:sites:docs": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad-docs",
    "dev:desktop": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @semio-tech/compose-desktop",
    "dev:ui": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @compose/ui",
    "dev:algorithms": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @semio-tech/compose-algorithms",
    "dev:sketchpad": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad",
    "dev:coda-desktop": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @semio-tech/coda-desktop",
    "build:engine": "npx nx build @semio-tech/compose-engine",
    "build:sites": "cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 npx nx run-many -t build -p @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad-docs @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad-play",
    "build:desktop": "npx nx build @semio-tech/compose-desktop",
    "build:3dm": "cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 npx nx run-many -t build -p @semio-tech/compose-rhino @semio-tech/compose-3dm-ui",
    "build:assets": "npm --workspace @semio-tech/compose-assets run build",
    "build:repo-cli": "npm run build:repo-client",
    "build:repo-client": "npx nx build @semio-tech/repo-client",
    "build:repo-server": "npx nx build @repo/server",
    "build:repo-vscode": "npx nx build repo",
    "build:coda-desktop": "npx nx build @semio-tech/coda-desktop",
    "publish:docs": "npx nx publish @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad-docs",
    "publish:play": "npx nx publish @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad-play",
    "publish:sketchpad": "npx nx publish @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad",
    "publish:desktop": "npx nx publish @semio-tech/compose-desktop",
    "publish:coda-desktop": "npx nx publish @semio-tech/coda-desktop",
    "postinstall": "node -e \"const cp=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const pkgPath=path.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules','lightningcss','package.json');if(!fs.existsSync(pkgPath))process.exit(0);const version=require(pkgPath).version;const report=process.report?.getReport?.();const libc=process.platform==='linux'?(report?.header?.glibcVersionRuntime?'gnu':'musl'):'';const key=[process.platform,process.arch,libc].filter(Boolean).join('/');const pkgByKey={'win32/x64':'lightningcss-win32-x64-msvc','win32/arm64':'lightningcss-win32-arm64-msvc','darwin/x64':'lightningcss-darwin-x64','darwin/arm64':'lightningcss-darwin-arm64','linux/x64/gnu':'lightningcss-linux-x64-gnu','linux/x64/musl':'lightningcss-linux-x64-musl','linux/arm64/gnu':'lightningcss-linux-arm64-gnu','linux/arm64/musl':'lightningcss-linux-arm64-musl'};const platformPkg=pkgByKey[key];if(!platformPkg)process.exit(0);if(fs.existsSync(path.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules',platformPkg)))process.exit(0);if(process.platform==='win32'){cp.execFileSync(process.env.ComSpec||'C:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\cmd.exe',['/d','/s','/c','npm install --no-save '+platformPkg+'@'+version],{stdio:'inherit'});}else{cp.execFileSync('npm',['install','--no-save',platformPkg+'@'+version],{stdio:'inherit'});}\"",
    "depcruise:layers": "npx -y dependency-cruiser@16 compose/js compose/react compose/sketchpad --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type err"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@eslint/js": "^10.0.1",
    "@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps": "^1.3.2",
    "@nxlv/python": "^21.2.3",
    "@types/node": "^22.19.6",
    "@types/react": "^19.2.8",
    "concurrently": "^9.2.1",
    "cross-env": "^10.1.0",
    "eslint": "^10.0.1",
    "globals": "^16.4.0",
    "jiti": "^2.4.2",
    "lint-staged": "^16.2.7",
    "nx": "^21.4.1",
    "react": "^19.2.3",
    "react-dom": "^19.2.3",
    "tsx": "^4.21.0",
    "typescript": "^5.9.3",
    "typescript-eslint": "^8.50.1",
    "vite-plugin-singlefile": "^2.3.2",
    "vitest": "^4.0.17"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "kit-of-parts",
    "port-based thinking",
    "shape grammar",
    "graph-based design",
    "graph transformations",
    "graph rewriting",
    "design prototypes",
    "design systems",
    "computer-based design synthesis",
    "computer-generated architecture",
    "generative design",
    "procedural modeling",
    "parametric design",
    "computer aided architectural design",
    "building information modeling"
  ],
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/usalu/semio.git"
  },
  "license": "AGPL-3.0-only",
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/usalu/semio/issues"
  },
  "homepage": "https://docs.semio-tech.com",
  "author": {
    "name": "Ueli Saluz",
    "email": "ueli@semio-tech.com",
    "url": "https://github.com/usalu"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "esbuild": "^0.27.2"
  },
  "overrides": {
    "diff": "^8.0.3",
    "tmp": "^0.2.5"
  }
}

  "dependencies": {

    "@semio-tech/compose-react": "*",

    "react": "^19.2.3",
    "react-dom": "^19.2.3",
    "three": "^0.182.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@mdx-js/rollup": "^3.1.1",
    "@playwright/test": "^1.57.0",
    "@semio-tech/compose-assets": "^1.0.0",
    "@tailwindcss/vite": "^4.1.13",
    "@types/mdx": "^2.0.13",
    "@types/node": "^25.0.8",
    "@types/react": "^19.2.8",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.2.3",
    "@vitejs/plugin-react": "^5.1.2",
    "cross-env": "^10.1.0",
